title: SubGHz
summary: A Flipper-zero inspired SubGHz app for the CardputerZero with the CC1101 Cap
description:
SubGHz turns your CardputerZero and Cap CC1101 into a portable Sub-GHz transceiver inspired by the Flipper Zero Sub-GHz app.

Browse, inspect, capture, and transmit .sub files, the same format used on the Flipper, across the 300–348 MHz, 387–464 MHz, and 779–928 MHz bands.
